messages.subject: Re: mirt1.7
parts:
Oh I see what you mean. Yes, this was a carryover omission that occurred due to switching classes recently (collapsing Exploratory and Confirmatory models into one SingleGroup class). The elements can still be obtained from coef() (meaning they were estimated), but summary() will miss their values). The printout fix for this has been pushed to the dev version.

Phil

messages.subject: Re: mirt1.7
parts:
Hi,Phil

thank you for your advice.

now I checked coef(), there is $GroupPars. This is factor correlation! thank you very much.

But in summery(), why do you change factor correlation like this;
Factor correlations: 
   F1 F2 F3
F1  1  0  0
F2  0  1  0
F3  0  0  1
 
you mean that if we calculate factor loading from item discrimination, the factor correlation will become orthogonality?

thanks

Yutaro  




2014年12月17日水曜日 17時09分22秒 UTC+9 Phil Chalmers:

Oh I see what you mean. Yes, this was a carryover omission that occurred due to switching classes recently (collapsing Exploratory and Confirmatory models into one SingleGroup class). The elements can still be obtained from coef() (meaning they were estimated), but summary() will miss their values). The printout fix for this has been pushed to the dev version.

Phil
